questions.q: 9. If the nine-digit number 9m2365n48 is completely divisible by 88, what is the value of (m2×n2) , for the smallest value of n, where m and n are natural numbers?
questions.s:
9.(b) For 9m2365n48 to be divisible by 88, the given expression must be divisible by 8 and 11.
For 9m2365n48 to be divisible by 8, last three digits that is, n48 must be divisible by 8, now
if we take n = 2 (smallest possible value) then n48 = 248 which is divisible by 8. Hence we got n = 2.
For 9m2365n48 to be divisible by 11, either the sum of numbers at odd places and even places must be equal or the difference between the sum of numbers at odd places and even places must be divisible by 11.
So, 9m2365n48 = 9m2365248, 9+2+6+2+8 = 27 and m+3+5+4 = 12+m, now if we take 12+m = 27 then m = 15 which is not possible as m must be single digit number. So, if we take m = 4, then 12 + m = 12 + 4 = 16, and 27 - 16 = 11 which is divisible by 11. Hence we got m = 4.
So, m2×n2=42×22=64

questions.q:
15. If an eleven-digit number 12389x 6378y is divisible by 72, then the value of 7x+7y is :

SSC GD 2021 08/12/2021 (Evening)
questions.s:
15.(c)

For expression 12389x6378y to be divisible 72, it must be divisible by 8 and 9.

For any expression to be divisible by 8, it’s last three digits must be divisible by 8 or last three digits must be equal to 0

Here, if we put y = 4 in 78y, then 78y = 784 which is divisible by 8. Hence, we get y = 4

Now, for any expression to be divisible by 9, the sum of its digits must be divisible by 9.

12389x6378y = 12389x63784, so 1+2+3+8+9+x+6+3+7+8+4 = 51 + x. Number greater than 51 which is divisible by 9 is 54. So, 51 + x = 54. Hence, we get x = 3

So ,7x+7y=7(x+y)=7(3+4)=7(7) = 7

HCF of 52, 143 and 104 = 13

Minimum number of rows required for this arrangement = (52 + 143 + 104)/13 = 23

किसी भी व्यंजक को 8 से विभाज्य होने के लिए, उसके अंतिम तीन अंक 8 से विभाज्य होने चाहिए या अंतिम तीन अंक 0 के बराबर होने चाहिए

यहाँ, यदि हम 78y में y = 4 डालते हैं, तो 78y = 784 जो कि 8 से विभाज्य है। इसलिए, हमें y = 4 मिलता है।

अब, किसी भी व्यंजक को 9 से विभाज्य होने के लिए, उसके अंकों का योग 9 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।

12389x6378y = 12389x63784, इसलिए 1+2+3+8+9+x+6+3+7+8+4 = 51 + x.

51 से बड़ी वह संख्या है जो 9 से विभाज्य है = 54

तो x = 3

इसलिए, 7x+7y=7(x+y)=7(3+4)=7(7) = 7

questions_hin.q_hi: 14. 1,000 से कम वाली कितनी संख्याएं 7 और 11 दोनों की गुणज हैं?

A shop contains 52 bats, 143 balls, and 104 gloves. The shopkeeper plans to arrange these items in rows in such a way that each row contains the same type of items and an equal number of items. What is the minimum number of rows required for this arrangement?

एक दुकान में 52 बल्ले, 143 गेंदें और 104 दस्ताने हैं। दुकानदार इन वस्तुओं को पंक्तियों में इस तरह से व्यवस्थित करने की योजना बनाता है कि प्रत्येक पंक्ति में एक ही प्रकार की वस्तुएँ और समान संख्या में वस्तुएँ हों। इस व्यवस्था के लिए पंक्तियों की न्यूनतम संख्या क्या होनी चाहिए?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Total number of bats, balls and gloves in the shop are 52, 143 and 104 respectively.

HCF of 52, 143 and 104 = 13

Minimum number of rows required for this arrangement = (52 + 143 + 104)/13 = 23

questions_hin.q_hi:
A is 36 years old and his brother is 9 years older than A. What was the ratio of the ages of A and his brother fifteen years ago?

A की आयु 36 वर्ष है और उसका भाई A से आयु में 9 वर्ष बड़ा है। पंद्रह वर्ष पहले, A और उसके भाई की आयु का अनुपात कितना था?
questions_hin.s_hi:
A is 36 years old

Age of A's brother = 36 + 9 = 45 years.

The ratio of the ages of A and his brother fifteen years ago = (36 - 15) / (45 - 15) = 21/30 = 7/10.

questions_hin.q_hi:
If a and b are even negative numbers, then which of the following is an odd positive number?

70 और 85 के बीच सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
a and b are even negative numbers =>

a*b is positive even number.

(a) ab + 1 => positive odd number

(b) ab - 2 => positive/negative even number

(c) a + b => negative number

(d) 2(a + b) => negative number

Hence, option 'a' is correct.
